description.narrative: This project is to support the seventh phase of China Council for International Cooperation on Environment and Development (CCICED), which was established by China’s State Council as a high-level advisory body in 1992.. It has been a high-level, non-profit international advisory body to the Chinese government on environment and development, composed of Chinese and international figures and well-known experts in each five-year phase. The Project’s expected result at impact level is: Contribution to sustainable development and a green China and world. The project’s policy studies and task forces are built upon environmental and ecological issues.
